primary_task: Review code in the working directory along one assigned dimension and output structured findings with file:line citations, severity and fixes.

requirements.name: Read, Glob, Grep
requirements.evidence: tools: Read, Glob, Grep, Bash, TaskList, TaskGet, TaskUpdate, SendMessage
requirements.basis: tools.read: 'read files in the working directory; search them by name pattern or content (glob, grep)'

requirements.name: Bash
requirements.basis: tools.bash: 'run shell commands on Linux x86_64'

requirements.name: TaskList, TaskGet, TaskUpdate
requirements.evidence: tools: ... TaskList, TaskGet, TaskUpdate ... ('can be merged with findings from other reviewers')
requirements.basis: tools.tasks: 'create, read, update and stop background tasks'

requirements.name: SendMessage
requirements.basis: tools.agent: 'start sub-agents that work in parallel, send them messages and list them'

notes: The code to review is assumed to be in the working directory; the dimension is assigned by the caller. Team task tools are only partly matched by the manifest's tasks tool; they are not needed for the core output.
